WHEREAS, pursuant to Resolution No.4397(Jan.27,2003), the City of Cheyenne
adopted the amendments to the Wyoming Retirement System Deferred Compensation Plan
regarding the deferred compensation plan governed by Section 457of the Internal Revenue Code
(the"Plan"), for its employees;
WHEREAS, pursuant to Resolution No.5984 (April 8,2019), the City of Cheyenne
reaffirmed its adoptionof the Plan and elected toimplement automatic enrollment into the Plan
for all newfull-time employees by establishing an Eligible Automatic Contribution Arrangement
in accordance with procedures established by the Wyoming Retirement System, in itsrole as the
Plan Administrator;
WHEREAS, in the Spring of2020, the Cityof Cheyenne Employee Benefits Committee
determined that all part-time employeesof the Cityof Cheyenne should be allowed to participate
in the Plan;
WHEREAS, in deciding to allow part-time employees of the City of Cheyenne to
participate in the Plan, it wasfurther decided to not authorize automatic enrollment for part-time
the Plan and, if so, the amount that the part-time employee elected to contribute; and
WHEREAS, to effectuate the decision to allow part-time employees of the City of
Cheyenne to participate in the Plan, Wyoming Retirement System staff advised City staff that
formal action by the Governing Body is needed.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the City hereby adopts the Plan for part-time employees,
effective upon the date of this Resolution as set forth below;
